node.statement: Choose k in {1,2} with delta_k=max(delta_1,delta_2). Both p_1 and p_2 lie in calU x B^{calH}_{delta_k}(J): p_k does by its inverse-domain membership, and for l different from k the inclusion B^{calH}_{delta_l}(J) subseteq B^{calH}_{delta_k}(J) follows from delta_l<=delta_k. Since every Pi_delta has the same formula (U,H)|->U bold-dot H, both pairs have Pi_{delta_k}-image X.
